lines: The facility's alarms blare. Red emergency lights bathe the servers.
You pull the drive, but the exit is blocked by heavily armed men.

m1.text: You have to use the ventilation shaft above the core. I'll overload the cooling system to create a distraction.

m2.text: You need to manually synchronize the fan frequencies so they tear themselves apart.

g1.text: Open the cloud to overload the cooling fans.

config.brief: Push the frequency and amplitude to their maximum structural limits to shatter the fan blades.

lines: A deafening screech fills the room as the massive exhaust fans shatter.
Thick white coolant smoke floods the room.
You scramble up the scaffolding and into the vents, completely unseen.

m4.text: We have the data. The governor, the cartel, Ardis... they are finished.

lines: You emerge into the freezing night air, miles from Hollowmere.
You look at the drive in your hand. The truth.
